lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like distribution of high-luminance circular clusters across the mid-lateral flank, showing roughly equidistant spacing between nodes despite distortion from surface light refraction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity intersecting horizontal spot rows to form a coordinate-like matrix, most visible in the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Linear feature along the upper third of the flank characterized by a sharp luminance gradient, with light-valued pixels on the dorsal side transitioning to shadow-toned pixels ventrally.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Cluster of approximately 8-10 distinct high-luminance blobs contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily localized to the mid-section of the fin surface.
